title: The Bard (character)
description:
[h2]The Bard: a new playable character[/h2]
A theatrical musician who fights with [b]Songs[/b]. Start a Song, build up [b]Verses[/b], trigger its [b]Refrain[/b] every turn and end with a big [b]Finale[/b]. Strong support for co-op.

HP 70. Starting relic: Worn Lute. 86 cards.

[h3]Good to know[/h3]
[list]
[*]Changes gameplay: everyone in a multiplayer lobby needs the same version.
[*]Requires BaseLib (subscribed automatically as a required item).
[*]Personal fan project, not affiliated with Mega Crit.
[/list]
